catalogEntry.authors: Adobe Systems Incorporated, Drew Noakes, Yakov Danila, Nathanael Jones
catalogEntry.description:
A port of Adobe's XMP SDK to .NET.
      Initially ported by Yakov Danila and Nathanael Jones.
      Now maintained by Drew Noakes and contributors on GitHub.
      The API should be familiar to users of Adobe's XMPCore 5.1.2, though it has been modified in places to better suit .NET development.

.NET library for working with the Extensible Metadata Platform (XMP)

This library is a port of Adobe's Java XMP SDK to .NET.  It was initially ported by Yakov Danila and Nathanael Jones. Now maintained by Drew Noakes and contributors on GitHub.

The API should be familiar to users of Adobe's XMPCore, though it has been modified in places to better suit .NET development.
